plan.line: a sound sensor module: a microphone with a comparator that says yes or no, is it louder than a set level right now (a clap, a knock, a shout). Its output goes LOW for a moment on each loud sound. It can't record sound, recognise words or measure volume.

code.pinLine: sound sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). value() goes 0 only for a moment (a few milliseconds) while a sound is louder than the level set with its screw, and is 1 otherwise. Read it very often (a loop with time.sleep_ms(1) or less), or catch it with Pin.irq(trigger=Pin.IRQ_FALLING); after a clap, ignore it for about 200 ms so one clap counts once.
code.ragQuery: GPIO digital input interrupt irq falling edge
